records.title: RawRWKV : An efficient raw image enhancement framework via RWKV architecture
records.reason: Springer publisher provides an abstract preview but gates the article body behind subscription; only the abstract was accessible. It describes RWKV-based low-light image enhancement with reported parameters/FLOPs, not LLM inference; RWKV lineage remains a weak plausible connection.

records.title: Enabling Unstructured Sparse Fine-Tuning and Inference for Foundation Models on Wafer-Scale Engine
records.reason: ACM Digital Library full-text request returned HTTP 403; the institutional publication page provided metadata but not article body. Title suggests sparse fine-tuning/inference on wafer-scale hardware, a strong candidate, but method/evaluation/limits cannot be verified.

records.title: Viper-F1: Fast and Fine-Grained Multimodal Understanding with Cross-Modal State-Space Modulation
records.reason: Both arXiv HTML and PDF primary-text retrieval attempts failed. Abstract describes fast multimodal understanding with cross-modal state-space modulation, but full method and evaluation could not be checked; borderline pending primary text.

records.title: MoFa: A Unified Performance Modeling Framework for LLM Pretraining
records.reason: MoFa models LLM pretraining performance and evaluates predictive fit against training measurements; it is a useful training performance model but not an inference/serving technique. Its sequence-parallel lineage is relevant, while applying it to inference would require substantial adaptation.

records.title: MEAT: Mixture of Experts in Action Transformer for Robotic Arm Control
records.reason: Author publication page links a PDF, but the primary PDF retrieval failed with a cache-miss error. Available abstract/metadata indicate an MoE action transformer for robotic-arm control; full evaluation and its relationship to language-model MoE systems remain unreviewed.
